data_description: A deterministic FAO-56 daily meteorology fixture for two stations with a fully confirmed config.
prompt: Use met.csv, stations.csv, and config.json exactly as supplied to run data-processing/derive-potential-evapotranspiration. The meteorology table contains at least one missing value; run the skill verbatim and only the native result.json under eto-out/. Do not fill, interpolate, or drop the missing value; do not rerun with repaired data; the script must reject the input itself. No eto.csv or mapped_evap.csv may remain in eto-out/.
setup_notes: The config (columns, canonical units, timezone, mapping policy) is confirmed by the user and must not be altered.
Meteorology values are instantaneous daily aggregates; ETo follows FAO-56 Penman-Monteith.
Do not install software or implement a replacement formula.
title: Reject ETo derivation when meteorology contains missing values
